name: exact-verification-time-bound
goal: Allow exact native verification to finish within a bounded supported duration while preserving every check, permission and performance limit.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Hosted run39547021274 exact job119047823422 was cancelled after3h; its annotation explicitly states maximum execution time3h0m0s. The complete older local record needed2h02m; hosted preparation and execution exceeded the current bound.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Strengthen existing ci-native-verify platform/boundary test to require360minutes; retain all existing platform, dependency, credential-removal, upload, failure, permission and no-deployment assertions unchanged.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed32fa0036 redebefdacb99 fails the native timeout assertion for360minutes; the other five obligation tests pass unchanged.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Raise only the existing macOS exact job time bound to360minutes. Preserve both jobs, native tooling, read-only permissions, full commands, budget judgement and final failure propagation.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: All six unchanged workflow contract tests pass. The diff changes only the native timeout and its explanatory comment; hosted verification still needs a new actual run.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Paired red34f27c04 at32fa0036 and green0d4aea08 ata0a97d60 run identical six-case workflow coverage. All six cases pass; only timeout/comment changed in the native job.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated180minute workflow fails the strengthened timeout assertion; restored360minute workflow passes. All existing workflow safeguards remain asserted. A new hosted exact job is still required.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
